preconditions.description: The number of rows n is between 1 and 5, and the number of columns m is between 1 and 20.
The input provides exactly n integers for row constraints and m integers for column constraints.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= r <= n for r in rows) and all(0 <= c <= m for c in cols)
preconditions.description: Each row constraint is a non-negative integer not exceeding the number of columns, and each column constraint is a non-negative integer not exceeding the number of rows.
It is guaranteed that at least one valid solution exists for the given constraints.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == n and all(len(line) == m for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly n lines, each containing exactly m characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in ['.', '*'] for line in stdout_lines for c in line)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output is either '.' (white) or '*' (black).

postconditions.expression: all(count_segments(line) == rows[i] for i, line in enumerate(stdout_lines))
postconditions.description: For every row i, the number of contiguous black segments in the output row matches the i-th input row constraint.

postconditions.expression: all(count_segments(''.join(stdout_lines[r][c] for r in range(n))) == cols[c] for c in range(m))
postconditions.description: For every column c, the number of contiguous black segments in the output column matches the c-th input column constraint.
